movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.tagline: Long live the fighters.
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.tagline: The world forever changes.
movies.description: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, probing the moral dilemma and political fallout that followed.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.tagline: Why so serious?
movies.description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on Gotham City, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.title: Inception
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movies.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
movies.description: A team of explorers travel through a newly discovered wormhole near Saturn in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival across alternate habitable worlds.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.
movies.description: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. When the heroes clash, Miles must redefine what it means to be a hero.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
movies.description: Years after witnessing the death of Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius must enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by tyrannical emperors who lead Rome with an iron fist.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.tagline: Come together.
movies.description: Wolverine is recovering from his injuries when he crosses paths with the loudmouth Deadpool. They team up to defeat a common enemy and save the multiverse.

movies.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
movies.tagline: Return to Pandora.
movies.description: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.tagline: Feel the need... the need for speed.
movies.description: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, but must confront ghosts of his past when he leads TOP GUN's elite graduates on an impossible mission.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
movies.tagline: Baba Yaga returns.
movies.description: John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

movies.title: Barbie
movies.tagline: She's everything. He's just Ken.
movies.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
movies.description: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.tagline: Part of the journey is the end.
movies.description: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

movies.title: The Batman
movies.tagline: Unmask the truth.
movies.description: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

movies.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
movies.tagline: The world is a stage.
movies.description: Arthur Fleck is institutionalized at Arkham awaiting trial for his crimes as Joker. While struggling with his dual identity, Arthur not only stumbles upon true love, but also finds the music that's always been inside him.

movies.title: Cyberpulse 2099
movies.tagline: The machine is awake. Humanity is on trial.
movies.description: In a neon-drenched metropolis under synthetic sky cover, a rogue cyber-detective uncovers a consciousness transfer conspiracy that threatens to replace humanity with artificial souls.

movies.title: Midnight Jazz & Rain
movies.tagline: Some melodies never fade away.
movies.description: A gifted but reclusive jazz pianist in 1950s Paris strikes an unexpected musical romance with an enigmatic singer running from an espionage syndicate.

movies.title: Jailer
movies.tagline: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian arrives to protect his family.
movies.description: Muthuvel Pandian, a strict yet retired jailer, sets out on a relentless quest to dismantle an eccentric crime syndicate and avenge the alleged murder of his police officer son.

movies.title: Free Guy
movies.tagline: Life is too short to be a background character.
movies.description: A bank teller discovers that he is actually an NPC inside a brutal open-world video game called Free City. Taking matters into his own hands, he decides to become the hero of his own story.
